status_plain: Readings of FV with a recorded Excel build: 2,531 input(s) over 3 recorded environment(s), Excel 16.0 build(s) 20131, 20228, 20430, all on Windows; where a CPU is recorded it is an AMD Zen 2. 789 input(s) were also read in captures that record no build (some may repeat inputs counted above); they are not counted. No input has been read in two environments, so no difference is known and none is ruled out. A CPU dependence is expected and untested (see below). No reading from a Mac, Excel for the web, 32-bit Excel or an Intel CPU is recorded.
